name: Emma Bellas Salon
hours: Mon 10 AM–9 PM; Tue 10 AM–9 PM; Wed 10 AM–9 PM; Thu 10 AM–6 PM; Fri 10 AM–9 PM; Sat 10 AM–5 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: I'm sorry but I have to mention the difference between my first visit 3 months ago vs the two times I came in within the past two weeks. The cheerful friendly environment I had encountered the first time was nonexistent without the additional staff present. With that said however I understand thing's happen for one reason or another be it sickness, vacation or something else. I waited for at least 45 minutes, felt like over an hour the second time coming in. Maybe I came at a bad time or maybe I needed an appointment ahead of time, whatever the case the difference was night and day between recently and a few months ago. I will go ahead and leave 3 stars since I did have one of the best haircuts from here before. I will also mention the parking lot as a side note, there has been a recent increase in panhandling but that is many places sadly, just something to be aware of.
The lady with curly hair did a good job on my hair. It’s a good vibe salon. She was very kind and sweet. Very attentive of what I wanted. I would be back.
Best haircut & beard trim I've had in 20 years. Emma is at the top of her game.
Wonderful haircut by a lovely stylist. The owner is a pillar in the Swannanoa community

This duo has officially done the hair of every person in my family. We are all so impressed. Eva did such an amazing job on mine and my step moms hair. Somehow after using all that lightener, my hair felt even better leaving the salon than it did when I came in. She was so magical. As an ex hairdresser I can say with 100% confidence that this girl KNOWS HER STUFF. She uses incredible quality products, takes her time, and knows exactly what she’s doing. I cannot recommend them enough.
Clean and welcoming. Grecia always does an amazing job, I highly recommend this salon!

Just had my hair cut by Grecia for the first time. She was amazing! She took the time to understand what I was looking for and to make suggestions on the cut and how to style it. I love my haircut and really enjoyed talking to Grecia.

Eva did a wonderful job on my hair. I can't thank her enough for the amazing new hair do! I would definitely recommend her salon to others. Her prices were great & her service was amazing! Thank you again! I will definitely be back!😊

Called last minute for a cut and highlights. I was lucky enough to get Grecian or "G" as she likes to be called and I am amazed. She knew exactly how to fix my bad color and haircut, and walked me through every step. Highly recommend this woman!!!!!

Emma did an absolutely gorgeous job on my eyebrows! I walked in there with very bushy long eyebrows and came out with such beautiful newly shaped and thinner ones!!! I absolutely recommend going there for your eyebrow waxing needs!!! 🖤 …
